description: Implementation of FileCacheReader class for reading files with caching, including path resolution and file size management.

classes.name: FileCacheReader
classes.description: Class for reading files with an internal cache, resolving file paths, and managing file size.

methods.name: FileCacheReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the file cache reader with a filename and cache size, resolving the full path.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, utilizing cache and refilling as needed.

methods.name: GetAbsolutePathName
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the file being read.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: EnsureFileOpened
methods.description: Opens the file if it is not already open.

methods.name: ReadFromCache
methods.description: Reads data from the internal cache into the output buffer.

methods.name: RefillCacheIfEmpty
methods.description: Refills the cache if it has been exhausted.
